wake_source.responsibility: Start a fresh reasoning invocation at the next supported opportunity.
wake_source.must_not_be_treated_as: proof that predecessor stayed alive or permission for dual substantive authority

reasoning_worker.responsibility: Perform useful checkpointable work while invocation exists.

durable_continuation.responsibility: Persist exact resumable state and side-effect evidence after meaningful units.

supervisor_measurement.responsibility: Detect stale workers, recover/transfer ownership, and measure useful coverage/dead gaps without inference.

scheduler_budget.rule: The 600-second bounded turn and 900-second fixed P0 window are distinct. Current fallback post-close cadence has an idealized ceiling below P0, so UTIL-EXP-018 may predictively arm the same canonical before target close while the predecessor continues useful work. Measure actual boundaries; never infer unknown time.

predictive_prearm.purpose: Hide scheduler delivery latency under predecessor useful work.

conditions: useful admissible work remained or fallback continuation was required
no terminal or safe continuation/transfer evidence exists
response: do not infer useful work across the gap
recover at next available verified wake
if repeated, target wake/runtime adapter rather than adding policy prose

rolling_recovery.startup: minimum fence then classify normal vs predictive vs recovery before substantive authority
rolling_recovery.normal_close: checkpoint then preserve verified predictive successor when canary active; otherwise same-canonical completion-relative fallback rearm and verify
rolling_recovery.mutation_failure: retry once when safe; if older verified future continuation survives, classify DEGRADED_CONTINUATION within its safety envelope; otherwise fail closed before conflicting substantive side effects
rolling_recovery.stale_occurrence: recover forward to newest verified schedule and never roll DTSTART or authority backward
